text:
Marta (Finance): Heads up — Spruce Networks sent invoice SPR-33421 for $12,450 but Coupa didn't match a PO. Vendor claims PO 6742-2025 but our system shows PO 6742 assigned to another vendor. Need routing/owner ASAP, due in 5 days.
Amit (ProcureOps): Can you paste the invoice PDF and vendor tax id? I’ll search legacy POs.
Marta (Finance): Uploading PDF now. Tax ID: 12-3456789. Vendor also emailed a signed SOW.
invoicer-bot: New invoice SPR-33421 uploaded by vendor (auto-match confidence: 0%).
Jules (EngOps): I remember a purchase request for Spruce last month — PR-987 created by @Nora. Might be the source of confusion.
Nora (Platform): Confirmed PR-987 exists but procurement never issued the PO — it was flagged for legal review and stalled. I can request PO creation if finance signs off on payment terms.
Amit (ProcureOps): Tagging @ryan (Product) — who owns the contract / SOW here?
ryan (Product): I don’t see this contract in our tracker. Who signed it?
Marta (Finance): Doc shows signature by an ex-ops lead (no current owner). Vendor is calling about late fees if not paid on time.
Amit (ProcureOps): Proposal: create a retro PO (one-off) and route to @Cecelia for retro approval and sign-off. Finance can then match and pay. Also need vendor mapping fix in Coupa.
Cecelia (Head of Ops): I can review & approve if you attach PR-987, the SOW, and a short justification explaining why PO wasn't created earlier. Also need GL code.
Marta (Finance): GL: 5200-PLATFORM-SERVICES. Attached PR link and SOW. Vendor bank last 4: 7621 — verified by phone.
Jules (EngOps): For Coupa, create PO titled "Retro PO - Spruce SPR-33421" with note: "payment pending; retro PO to clear invoice". Set approvers to Cecelia and Finance. I can create the PO if you confirm vendor details.
Marta (Finance): Confirmed bank ending 7621 and W-9 on file.
Amit (ProcureOps): I'll create PO 6742-2025-retro now and route to Cecelia. Once approved, Finance to mark invoice matched and release payment.
ryan (Product): Confirmed no change to product scope. Good to proceed.
Marta (Finance): Vendor requested a 2-day turnaround to waive late fee. Can we expedite?
Cecelia (Head of Ops): I’ll review immediately when PO shows up. @aLina-FS please prioritize the payment sweep if I approve.
aLina-FS (Payments): Noted — will queue for next expedited sweep once invoice is marked matched and approved.
Marta (Finance): Thanks everyone :pray: — will follow up when PO is created and approval flows through.
